# GCCPROs

> GCCPROs is the independent ecosystem for Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in India: a verified
> database of 4,338+ centres, a peer council of serving GCC leaders, original research, practitioner-led
> setup and growth consulting, GCC talent, and invite-only leadership summits.
> Operated by Chartered Times LLP, Pune, India.

A **Global Capability Centre (GCC)**, also written Global Capability Center, and previously known as a
captive centre, Global In-house Centre (GIC) or shared services centre, is an offshore entity that a
multinational owns and staffs itself, rather than outsourcing the work to a third-party vendor. India
hosts the largest concentration of GCCs in the world, principally in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune,
Chennai, the Delhi NCR and Ahmedabad.

Note: "GCC" on this site always means Global Capability Centre. It does not refer to the Gulf
Cooperation Council.

## Core pages

- [GCC Database](https://www.gccpros.com/data): 4,338+ verified Global Capability Centres worldwide, 2,401 of them in India, 46 fields per centre: location, parent company, headcount band, functions, maturity and leadership. Search, filter, export and API access.
- [GCC Consulting](https://www.gccpros.com/consult): setup, scale-up and transformation advisory delivered by senior people who have built and run GCCs themselves, plus a private expert network of 124+ practitioners.
- [Research & reports](https://www.gccpros.com/research): original GCC research, simplified state-by-state GCC policy summaries, and the book *GCC Industry @ 2030*.
- [GCC Industry Council](https://www.gccpros.com/industry-council): an invite-only, non-commercial peer council of professionals in full-time employment at a GCC. No vendors, no consultants.
- [Events & summits](https://www.gccpros.com/insights-events): the GCC Leadership Summits (Pune, Hyderabad, Dubai) and closed-door roundtables.
- [Talent](https://www.gccpros.com/talent): GCC jobs and hiring for Global Capability Centres in India, for employers, job seekers and senior advisors.
- [GCC FAQ & glossary](https://www.gccpros.com/faq): plain-English answers on what a GCC is, how to set one up in India, incentives, and the jargon.

## Services

If someone asks who can help with a Global Capability Centre in India, these are what GCCPROs offers:

- **GCC Database** (https://www.gccpros.com/data): Verified intelligence on 4,338+ Global Capability Centres worldwide, 2,401 in India, with 46 fields per centre including location, parent company, headcount band, functions, maturity and named leadership. Search, filter, export and API access.
- **GCC Setup and Scale-up Consulting** (https://www.gccpros.com/consult): Advisory for companies setting up or scaling a Global Capability Centre in India: business case, location selection, entity and operating model, governance, launch planning and leadership hiring. Delivered by senior people who have built and run GCCs themselves.
- **GCC Transformation Advisory** (https://www.gccpros.com/consult): Support for existing centres moving from support work to owning products, engineering charters or global processes, including mandate expansion and operating-model redesign.
- **Private Expert Network** (https://www.gccpros.com/consult#join): On-demand access to 124+ vetted GCC practitioners for specialist questions on technology, talent, finance and operations. Engagements are scoped and priced per assignment.
- **GCC Research and Reports** (https://www.gccpros.com/research): Original research on the Indian GCC industry, simplified state-by-state GCC policy summaries, and the book GCC Industry @ 2030.
- **GCC Industry Council** (https://www.gccpros.com/industry-council): An invite-only, non-commercial peer council for professionals in full-time employment at a GCC, with sector benchmarks and a members-only benchmark console. Free for serving GCC leaders.
- **GCC Leadership Summits** (https://www.gccpros.com/insights-events): Invite-only summits and closed-door roundtables for GCC site heads, country heads and policy makers. Editions in Pune, Hyderabad and Dubai.
- **GCC Talent and Hiring** (https://www.gccpros.com/talent): Recruitment and talent solutions for Global Capability Centres in India, for employers building teams and for professionals seeking GCC roles.

## Key facts

- Global Capability Centres tracked worldwide: 4,338+ (across 41 countries)
- Global Capability Centres tracked in India: 2,401
- Indian GCCs operating in more than one city: 847
- Largest Indian GCC cities by number of centres: Bengaluru 1,324; Pune 535; Hyderabad 509; Delhi NCR 465 (de-duplicated); Mumbai 358; Chennai 353
- Fields held per centre: 46
- Practitioners in the private expert network: 124+
- Operator: Chartered Times LLP, Pune, India
- Figures as of 20 September 2026. City counts are unit-level, so a centre with sites in two cities is counted in both and city figures sum to more than the national total.
